Provide the declared support and its marked region clear_box_visibility_station; a region can belong to the same physical fixture rather than requiring a separate object.

success_criteria: The colored blocks occupy the marked positions inside the open clear box and each remains visible through the box wall.
The visibility audit checklist identifies every block and view, while the lid remains off; no storage capacity is inferred.
setup: Open and empty the clear box, mark three visibility positions, stage the colored blocks and checklist, and keep the lid off.
reset: Remove the blocks from the clear box, return them and the box to staging, and clear the visibility checklist.
quality_checks: Verify the box is the named clear box, each block is visible from the declared view, positions are recorded, and no lid closure or capacity claim is made.
failure_modes: A block is hidden, substituted, outside its mark, the lid is placed, the box is unstable, or visibility is treated as evidence of storage capacity.

requirements.reason: Required catalog or collection resource ycb_068_clear_box.
Required catalog or collection resource rim_alignment_gauge.
Required catalog or collection resource fit_observation_log.
Provide the declared support and its marked region lid_alignment_station; a region can belong to the same physical fixture rather than requiring a separate object.

success_criteria: The lid is aligned above the clear-box rim with all corners registered and no pressure applied.
The observed rim gap is recorded on the fit log with 1 mm tolerance, and the lid remains unclosed.
setup: Place the open clear box on the alignment station, stage a 1 mm-resolution rim gauge and fit log, mark lid orientation, and declare the no-force fit protocol.
reset: Lift the lid clear of the rim and return the lid, box, gauge, and log to their staging positions.
quality_checks: Verify lid and box identities, corner registration, visible rim clearance, no pressure or closure, and the recorded 1 mm-tolerance observation.
failure_modes: The lid is pressed or closed, corners are misregistered, the rim is occluded, the gauge or log is absent, or fit is inferred without an observation.

requirements.reason: Required catalog or collection resource block_sort_record.
Provide the declared fixture or collection resource block_sort_mat used by the initial or final state.

success_criteria: Every colored block lies flat in the zone matching its observed color and size, with no blocks overlapping.
The group membership and count are recorded on the visible block-sort record without inferring unseen material properties.
setup: Separate the colored blocks on a clear mat, label zones using observed color and size, stage the block-sort record, and declare the grouping rule.
reset: Collect the blocks from each zone, return the set and record to staging, and clear the sorting mat.
quality_checks: Verify every block is visible and counted once, each zone label matches the observation, and no construction or load result is claimed.
failure_modes: A block is hidden, stacked, misgrouped, or substituted, a zone is unlabeled, or the record asserts a property not observed.

requirements.reason: Required catalog or collection resource peg_reference_camera.
Required catalog or collection resource hole_visibility_checklist.
Provide the declared support and its marked region peg_visibility_station; a region can belong to the same physical fixture rather than requiring a separate object.

success_criteria: The peg-test apparatus edges align to both station marks, all holes are visible, and no peg is inserted.
The empty-hole visibility result is recorded on the named checklist from the fixed camera reference.
setup: Clear the station, stage the reference camera and hole checklist, mark both alignment edges, and confirm that all holes start empty.
reset: Remove the apparatus from the marks, return it and the camera/checklist to staging, and leave all holes empty.
quality_checks: Verify apparatus identity, edge alignment, empty-hole count, camera view, and checklist completeness; do not infer peg-test performance.
failure_modes: A hole is occluded or occupied, an edge is misaligned, the camera view is absent, the wrong apparatus is used, or test performance is inferred.

Required catalog or collection resource aircraft_clearance_log.

Provide the declared fixture or collection resource aircraft_clearance_arch used by the initial or final state.

success_criteria: The toy airplane passes inside the marked arch with both wings clear and its nose at the marked stop.
The minimum wing clearance is recorded on the visible log with 5 mm tolerance; no flight or aerodynamic result is inferred.
setup: Mark the clearance arch and nose stop, stage a 5 mm-resolution wing gauge and log, declare the 5 mm tolerance, and clear the pad.
reset: Remove the toy airplane from the arch, return it to the pad mark, and restore the gauge and log to staging.
quality_checks: Verify airplane identity, arch and nose-stop alignment, both wing clearances, gauge reading, and log completeness.
failure_modes: A wing contacts the arch, the nose misses its stop, the gauge or log is absent, the wrong airplane is used, or flight performance is claimed.

success_criteria: The Duplo brick lies fully inside the marked footprint with studs up and its edges aligned to the frame.
The edge alignment is recorded on the pose log with 1 mm tolerance, and the brick remains unconnected.
setup: Mark the Duplo footprint, stage a 1 mm-resolution edge gauge and pose log, declare the no-connection rule and tolerance, and clear the station.
reset: Remove the unconnected brick from the footprint and return the brick, gauge, and log to staging.
quality_checks: Verify brick identity, studs-up orientation, footprint containment, edge alignment, no mate connection, and log completeness.
failure_modes: The brick is connected, inverted, outside the footprint, misaligned, substituted, or recorded without the declared edge observation.

success_criteria: The closed magazine stands upright in the clear rack slot with its spine visible at the marked reference.

quality_checks: Verify magazine identity, upright support, spine visibility, closed pages, rack stability, and log completeness.
failure_modes: The magazine falls, leans outside the slot, pages open, the spine is hidden, the rack shifts, or reading content is inferred.

success_criteria: The timer rests in the marked alert zone with its display facing the observer and its controls untouched.

setup: Mark and clear the alert zone, stage the orientation card and placement log, and declare that controls and settings must remain untouched.
reset: Lift the timer from the alert zone without touching its controls and return it to the staging surface with the pose card and log.
quality_checks: Verify timer identity, display-facing orientation, zone containment, untouched controls, unchanged setting, and log completeness.
failure_modes: A control is pressed, the setting changes, the display faces away, the timer overhangs the zone, or alarm behavior is inferred.
